_comment: Hand-verified license readings, keyed by repo slug. GitHub's API collapses every license it cannot identify into spdx_id NOASSERTION (name 'Other'), so a source-available license and a bespoke permissive one look identical in the metadata. Where we opened the license file ourselves, the real terms are recorded here. `stack_eligible` overrides the metadata-derived verdict: the corpus builders scan license TEXT, not GitHub's label.

basecamp/fizzy.note: MIT-style grant plus a clause forbidding use as a competing hosted/SaaS product, so it is not permissive.
